triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: Chapter 88's composition gated its §301/§201/§232-aluminum/§338 components on equality against five HTS lines from other chapters, so the gates were constant false for any 88xx entry and the components were dead, with proof atoms citing provisions outside this chapter.

triage.verifier_justification: The diff for ch88.yaml is 104 deleted lines and 4 added (summary only): it removes five derived rules whose formulas were bare equality tests against statistical reporting numbers in chapters 72, 76, 95, 22 and 85, each with proof atoms citing those out-of-chapter provisions, inside a chapter-88 module. Those flags are the gates for this chapter's §301, §122 temporary-import-surcharge, §201, §232-aluminum and §338 components, and for semantic rules such as entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded (source: "Chapter 99 U.S. note reciprocal annex exclusion list under heading 9903.01.32", formula: entry_is_line_a) and entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded (source: "HTS 9903.01.33 section 232 metals article scope", formula: entry_is_line_b) — so the module asserted a chapter-99 class membership while implementing "hts_number == 7202.11.10.00", a condition with no basis in the cited source for any 88xx entry. Removing those derivations and making the identifiers caller inputs re-grounds branches that were grounded on the wrong provision, which is untraceable_branch, not a provenance-only edit; the summary's boilerplate "runtime semantics are unchanged" is contradicted by the PR's own removal-aware ledger (−500 removed exemplar-flag outputs) and by its statement that the exemplar coupling "unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins".
triage.verifier_notes: Refutation attempts and why they fail. (1) Mechanical: rejected — whole rules with formulas and proof atoms are deleted, the module's declared input surface gains five caller inputs and loses five derived outputs (PR: "removal-aware pending ledger — −500 removed exemplar-flag outputs", i.e. 5 per chapter over 100 chapters), so formulas/inputs/outputs did not stay the same. (2) not_a_defect (pilot-scope enhancement): rejected — the module does not disclaim these gates; it affirmatively names the semantics (entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded / entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded / china_section_301_component_rate) with chapter-99 proof atoms while implementing single foreign-chapter line equality, so the pre-fix encoded meaning disagreed with the cited source rather than merely omitting coverage. (3) Alternative kind wrong_entity_or_scope is arguable (a single exemplar line standing in for a whole covered class), but the kind rubric puts "formulas grounded on the wrong provision" under untraceable_branch, and the fix's action is removal/re-grounding, not a scope re-targeting. Caveats for a reviewer: this commit does not re-gate any component formula in ch88 — the §301/§122/§201/§338 formulas still reference entry_is_line_a..e verbatim (post lines 2572, 2648, 2816, 2994-2998); the "membership-semantic" re-gating described in the PR body happens elsewhere in the stack. Also, if the engine defaults an unsupplied input to false, evaluated values for a caller that supplies nothing would be identical to pre-fix; the meaning change is that the module stops asserting a false grounding and hands class membership to entry preparation. Verified read-only via git show of parent 956a547418 and 2a6bdb01de.
